_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Rivals: websift/seek-job-scraper $0.0025/result + $0.003 'salary finder' (250 monthly users), blackfalcondata (308), bovi (159). job_row $0.003 with full description and parsed salary included, job_row_basic $0.002 listing only. No start fee, no per-run allowance (scheduled with onlyNew). No proxy: search answered 10/10 from Apify IPs.

job_row.eventDescription: One Seek job (Australia or New Zealand) with title, company, location, salary text and parsed range, work type, remote or hybrid, category, listing date, teaser, bullet points and full description. A run that returns no jobs is free.

job_row_basic.eventDescription: One Seek job with the same fields but no full description (Full description off, or the description could not be read).
